run_SemanticPredDetic_get_prediction: run SemanticPredDetic.get_prediction to get semantic segmentation masks and visualized output from an input image
create_ImageSegmentation: create an ImageSegmentation instance that initializes a Detic model with COCO vocabulary and confidence threshold settings
run_BatchPredictor_call: run BatchPredictor on a list of BGR images to get instance segmentation predictions from the Detic model
run_compress_sem_map: run compress_sem_map to collapse a multi-channel semantic map into a single-channel compressed category map
setup_setup_cfg: setup a Detectron2 config with Detic and CenterNet settings, confidence thresholds, and classifier paths
